subject: Amendment Required for Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

We found discrepancies that require your attention and amendment.

The Consignee is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but the draft Bill of Lading states UAB NOVAKOPA.

Please update the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
